title: ¡Tito no se quiere bañar! 😱🛁 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: backyard after rain (mud puddles, clothesline) + turquoise bathroom with bubble tub
story: Mamá offers a bath, Tito refuses: no, no, no (conflict)
Tito runs and hides behind a sheet on the clothesline (escape)
He discovers a tub of rainbow bubbles and a rubber duck (curiosity wins)
Splash! He jumps in, foam flies (climax)
Mamá scrubs, mud melts away (the habit)
He spots a mud puddle again (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¡Tito está sucio!
[Verse]
¿A bañarse? ¡No, no, no!
¡Tito corre y se esconde!
¡Mira, mira! ¡Burbujas!
[Chorus]
¡Splash, splash, splash!
¡Agua y jabón!
¡Fuera barro, fuera!
[Outro]
¡Limpito y feliz!
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.

locations.patio: A backyard just after the rain, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: wet green grass, big brown mud puddles, a clothesline with white sheets gently moving, a pair of small yellow rain boots, a little wooden fence and a bright sky with soft clouds after the rain. Nobody is in the yard.
locations.bano: A cheerful bathroom, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: turquoise and white tiles, a big white clawfoot bathtub overflowing with fluffy white foam and rainbow soap bubbles, a plain yellow rubber duck toy floating on the foam, a small window with warm sunlight, a fluffy yellow towel on a hook. Nobody is in the bathroom.

shots: Extreme close-up: the baby elephant's face covered in brown mud splats, a drop of mud dripping from his ear, a guilty toothy grin, looking slightly to the side, the wet backyard softly blurred behind.
A drop of mud falls from his ear, he blinks and grins guiltily.
Medium shot in the wet backyard: Mamá Elefanta holds a fluffy yellow towel and a plain yellow rubber duck toy, smiling kindly; next to her the muddy baby elephant crosses his arms and pouts.
The baby elephant shakes his head no with his arms crossed; Mamá tilts her head patiently.
Wide shot of the wet backyard after the rain: the muddy baby elephant peeks out from behind a white sheet hanging on the clothesline, a trail of little muddy footprints leads to him.
The sheet sways in the breeze, the baby elephant peeks out and giggles.

Medium shot in the bathroom: a big white bathtub overflowing with fluffy foam and rainbow soap bubbles, a yellow rubber duck toy on the foam; the muddy baby elephant peeks in from the doorway with huge curious eyes.
Rainbow bubbles drift up, the duck bobs on the foam, the baby elephant leans in curiously.
Medium shot: the baby elephant sits in the bubble bath, a big splash of water and foam flying around him, laughing with joy.
Water splashes up and foam flies, the baby elephant laughs.
Close-up: the baby elephant in the bath with a white bubble beard and a tall bubble hat, laughing, rainbow bubbles around.
A bubble pops on his nose and he giggles.
Close-up insert: Mamá Elefanta's trunk holds a soft sponge and scrubs the baby elephant's back in the bath, brown mud melting into the foamy water.
The sponge moves in slow circles, foam spreads, the mud washes away.
Medium shot: the clean baby elephant wrapped in a fluffy yellow hooded towel with little duck ears hugs Mamá Elefanta, tiny sparkles around them, the bathroom behind.
They hug and sway gently, sparkles twinkle.
Wide shot of the wet backyard: the clean baby elephant in soft pajamas stands next to a big mud puddle, one foot raised above it, a mischievous grin.
He lifts his foot over the puddle with a sneaky grin.
